title: Best Gaming Laptops (2026)
summary: 5 top-rated gaming laptops from budget RTX 5050 to a high-end RTX 5080 desktop replacement.
method: Picks come from PCWorld's hands-on laptop testing (updated Oct 2026). Specs and battery figures are for the configuration they tested; Amazon listings can differ, so check the exact configuration before buying. We don't show prices because they change daily. Gaming picks are ordered around how you play: value, all-round performance, portability and maximum power.
assumptions: no budget was specified, so the list runs from about the $1,000 class up to enthusiast machines.
